changelog: Uses the shared typed runtime API for a native pitch-rate controller, glider stamina and four ItemInfo controls. Independent mod with automatic API restoration. Upward tilt is prepared for live verification in pitch-speed input mode.

unlimitedFlying.label: Unlimited Flying
unlimitedFlying.description: Allows upward glider tilt without glider stamina drain. Requires pitch-speed controls and one player in the authoritative world. The sampled upward control must be verified in the live game.

turnSpeed.label: Turn Speed
turnSpeed.description: Multiplier for the original glider yaw rate. 100% keeps the item value.

moveSpeed.label: Move Speed
moveSpeed.description: Multiplier for the original forward acceleration coefficient. 100% keeps the item value.

liftSpeed.label: Lift Speed
liftSpeed.description: Multiplier for the original longitudinal air resistance. This field is a drag coefficient, so higher values increase resistance.

descendSpeed.label: Descend Speed
descendSpeed.description: Multiplier for the original vertical air resistance. This field is a drag coefficient, so higher values increase resistance.

groups.label: Unlimited Flight
groups.description: Uses the active glider's original controls. ItemInfo settings are shared by every user of the same glider type. Speed sliders apply once that glider is used.
